query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM ticket_comments
                WHERE org_id = $1 AND author_id = $2
                  AND created_at >= $3 AND created_at < $4
           ) OR EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM timer_sessions
                WHERE org_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
                  AND started_at < $4
                  AND COALESCE(stopped_at, now()) >= $3
           ) AS activity
